why: Tony, 19 October 2026: "The Hopi article and council fire have to lead for the rest of the week." Pinned to the front of the magazine and the journal's newest three until the end of the day below; after that the normal newest-first order returns by itself. Then (Tony): "global launch, Barnes and Noble etc of Stone Breath and also Far Messengers" — Stone Breath's worldwide launch third, The Far Messengers fourth once it is published.
